scripts.text: Request
scripts.translation: 提交请求

scripts.text: Cancel

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
This is Monster Information Retrieval System. Information of the monsters that appear in this dungeon can be searched. Enter Monster Name, including spaces, when searching.
scripts.translation:
[魔物信息检索系统]
这里是魔物信息检索系统，可查询当前迷宫中出现的魔物。搜索时请输入魔物名称，包括名称中的空格。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Dungeon]
Caution! Geffen Dungeon consists of 3 levels that are too dangerous for new adventurers. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
Recommended for players around level 60~70.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬地下城]
注意！吉芬地下城共有3层，对新手冒险者来说十分危险。如有信息需要补充或修正，请告知冒险者团体。
建议等级：60～70级。

scripts.text:
[Orc Dungeon]
Orc Dungeon is comprised of 2 floors. Monsters that appear in this dungeon are not strong individually, but adventurers may be overwhelmed by the number. Holy element weapons will make adventurer's life easier in this dungeon. You can also utilize Priest skill, Aspersio.
scripts.translation:
[兽人地下城]
兽人地下城共有2层。这里的魔物单体并不强，但常常成群出现，冒险者可能招架不住。
使用圣属性武器，或服用牧师技能“洒水祈福”赋予武器圣属性，会更容易应对。

[Juperos Ruins]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --

- Name : Poring
- Element : Neutral

[Comodo West Cave, Karu]
This dungeon introduces Medusa monster that will surely cause you to turn to stone if you look at it in the eyes. There are no other exits in this cave.
scripts.translation:
[克魔岛西洞·卡鲁]
这里栖息着米杜沙。只要直视它的眼睛，就会变成石头。
这座洞穴没有其他出口。

scripts.text: <Tao Gunka? That monster with huge face? How strong is it? It's weak.. very weak.. Oh!! It might be strong for you.. - Trolling Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <塔奥群卡？就是那个大脸魔物吗？它有多强？弱得很...真的很弱...哦！！对你来说可能挺强...——爱捉弄人的探险家葡萄>

scripts.text:
[Comodo North Cave, Ruande]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --
scripts.translation:
[克魔岛北洞·鲁安德]
为了让冒险者轻松愉快地环游世界，我们将各地冒险者收集到的信息公之于众。
如有信息需要补充或修正，请告知冒险者团体。
-- 冒险者团体 --

scripts.text:
[Payon Cave]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --
scripts.translation:
[斐扬洞穴]
为了让冒险者轻松愉快地环游世界，我们将各地冒险者收集到的信息公之于众。
如有信息需要补充或修正，请告知冒险者团体。
-- 冒险者团体 --

[Starlight Reef]

Monster Information Retrieval System

scripts.text:
[Geffenia]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --
scripts.translation:
[吉芬尼亚]
为了让冒险者轻松愉快地环游世界，我们将各地冒险者收集到的信息公之于众。
如有信息需要补充或修正，请告知冒险者团体。
-- 冒险者团体 --

You have signed the contract with '^0000FFRenkenber^000000', the following information are now available. To revise the information, contact Adventurer Group or '^0000FFRenkenber^000000'with information tip.
-- Adventurer Group --
scripts.translation:
[塔纳托斯之塔向导]
你已与^0000FF雷根贝勒^000000签订契约，现在可以查看以下信息。如需修正，请联系冒险者团体，或向^0000FF雷根贝勒^000000提供线索。
-- 冒险者团体 --

scripts.text: Look up monsters by floor
scripts.translation: 按楼层查找魔物

scripts.text: Monster Information Retrieval System
scripts.translation: 怪物信息检索系统

scripts.text: Request
scripts.translation: 提交请求

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Requested information will appear - There's no problem if it appears
scripts.translation: 请求的信息将显示在这里。只要能正常显示，就没有问题。

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
This is Monster Information Retrieval System. Information of the monsters that appear in this dungeon can be searched. Enter Monster Name, including spaces, when searching.
scripts.translation:
[魔物信息检索系统]
这里是魔物信息检索系统，可查询当前迷宫中出现的魔物。搜索时请输入魔物名称，包括名称中的空格。

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
Now searching
scripts.translation:
[魔物信息检索系统]
正在搜索...

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
Search has been completed.
Now showing the search results.
scripts.translation:
[魔物信息检索系统]
搜索完成。
正在显示搜索结果。
